title: POV: You Wake Up in Çatalhöyük — A Dense Neolithic Settlement #shorts
description:
Step into Çatalhöyük, reconstructed as a cinematic historical short using archaeological evidence and cautious interpretation. Some details remain debated or uncertain.

#history #archaeology #lostworlds #ancienthistory #shorts
image_style: cinematic archaeological documentary film still, photorealistic, historically plausible reconstruction, natural skin texture, authentic materials and tools, atmospheric natural light, 35mm lens, realistic scale, no modern objects, no fantasy, no text, no logo, no watermark

scenes.text: You approach a dense Neolithic settlement on the Anatolian plain.
scenes.image: Catalhoyuk reconstruction, tightly packed mudbrick houses, Anatolian plain

scenes.text: Homes press wall against wall, with many entrances reached from the rooftops.
scenes.image: people moving across connected rooftops, ladders into houses, realistic

scenes.text: Inside, families cook, work, sleep, and bury some of their dead beneath house floors.
scenes.image: Neolithic house interior, hearth, platforms, respectful non-graphic burial context

scenes.text: Walls are replastered repeatedly and some rooms carry paintings and modeled features.
scenes.image: plastered interior with geometric and animal imagery, plausible reconstruction

scenes.text: Farmers grow crops and keep animals while hunting and gathering still contribute to life.
scenes.image: Anatolian Neolithic farming, sheep, grain, gathering, no modern tools

scenes.text: Obsidian from volcanic regions becomes an important material for sharp tools and exchange.
scenes.image: obsidian toolmaking and exchange, close documentary scene

scenes.text: The settlement changes over many generations rather than following a single urban plan.
scenes.image: layers of rebuilt mudbrick houses, archaeological stratigraphy visual

scenes.text: Excavation reveals an unusually detailed record of household life.
scenes.image: archaeologists uncovering mudbrick rooms and artifacts, realistic

scenes.text: No streets, few doors at ground level, and a citylike density. Could you find your house?
scenes.image: wide rooftop view across occupied Catalhoyuk at sunset
